title: StockMarketView
description: Advanced stock analysis dashboard modeled after Tickertape. Features a Market Mood Index (MMI) gauge visualizer, 5-pillar scorecards (valuation, growth, profitability, entry point, red flags), checklist audits, and sector benchmarking.

title: JeevanTrust
description: Enterprise-grade loan and insurance management monorepo dashboard. Engineered with Next.js web client, a shared core TypeScript business library, Zod validation, offline localStorage cache fallback, and Supabase backend integration.

title: Equity Fund Tracker
description: Building a financial dashboard with SIP calculator, fund comparison, and NAV performance visualization. Designing reusable component architecture and scalable state management for real-time financial data.

title: Chatbot UI
description: Built a dynamic chatbot interface with real-time message rendering and conversational flow handling. Designed for extensibility — architected to plug into any AI/LLM backend (OpenAI, Claude API).

title: AI Nutrition Tracker
description: Smart calorie tracking app using Natural Language Processing. Simply type 'I ate an apple' to get real-time macro analysis via Python & CalorieNinjas API.

title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-stack e-commerce solution with product catalog, cart management, and secure payment processing.
